verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth explicitly documents cloud sync (iCloud/Google Drive) to protect against phone loss/damage, plus import from other authenticator apps and a dedicated recovery guide/decryption kit for the Pass vault, giving users a documented path to restore tokens on a new device. Community evidence corroborates that sync/backup features exist (via WebDAV/iCloud) though notes multi-device sync is a paid-tier feature for Pass. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a successful full-device-loss recovery flow, and clarity on whether password-encrypted backups are recoverable without the original device if password is forgotten.
